steps.title: Five actors, eleven messages
steps.body: The PC runs `uuu`. It first talks to the Boot ROM, then to the SPL, then to U-Boot's fastboot gadget. U-Boot does every write to the eMMC. Time runs downward.

steps.title: Start: the board is in serial download
steps.body: With the switch on SD and no card, the ROM finds nothing to boot and falls back to USB serial download. The PC sees `1fc9:0146`, which the script checks with `lsusb` before it starts.

steps.title: 1: one command streams the boot image
steps.body: `SDPS` is the stream protocol of this ROM. The ROM copies the SPL to on-chip RAM and starts it. No separate image is needed: it is the same `imx-boot.bin` that goes on an SD card.

steps.title: 2: the SPL needs more
steps.body: The SPL trains the LPDDR4 memory, then asks the ROM through its API for the rest of the image. The ROM keeps reading from USB.

steps.anchor: rest of imx-boot.bin: DDR firmware, BL31, U-Boot
steps.title: 3: the rest arrives over USB
steps.body: The same stream carries the DDR firmware, TF-A BL31 and U-Boot proper. This is where a USB hub or dock can break the hand-over.

steps.title: 4: U-Boot notices it was started from USB
steps.body: It prints a line about booting from USB, and instead of looking for a kernel it runs `fastboot 0`. The USB port becomes a new device, `1fc9:0152`, which `uuu` waits for.

steps.anchor: FB: ucmd setenv fastboot_dev mmc ; mmc dev ${emmc_dev}
steps.title: 5: aim at the module's eMMC
steps.body: `emmc_dev` is 2 in Variscite's environment. The SD slot is device 1, so it is never selected.

steps.title: 6-7: the user area
steps.body: The SD-card image is written to the eMMC user area, sending only blocks that contain data. This gives the partition table, the root filesystem at 8 MiB and a copy of the boot image at 32 KiB.

steps.anchor: mmc write → boot0 and boot1, offset 0
steps.title: 8-9: the boot partitions
steps.body: `imx-boot.bin` is downloaded into RAM once and written to boot0 and boot1 at offset 0, where the ROM wants it when a boot partition is enabled.

steps.title: 10: tell the eMMC to boot from boot0
steps.body: This sets `PARTITION_CONFIG`: boot acknowledge on, boot partition 1 (boot0). Without it the ROM would ignore boot0. Then `FB: done` ends the script, and you flip the switch to eMMC.
